vortex._source: vortex_of_greed.json: official FAQ 2025-08, the response in the recording 2026-10-15 (store and weekly limit), the client's texts; tools/major_content.py
vortex._adaptation: Aliens have 1.5 times the HP/shield of their normal types (the source only says "more HP"); the treasure holder's reward 500 SC + 1 CNC + title; evacuation radius 500 and locations 3,000 away from the player; the coins carried on death: SAE_SHIP_BOX; single map (483); Vanguard for uridium (shop).

laser.direction: From the Fortress toward the locked target, to the edge of the map

world_boss._source: world_boss_2025.json: resmî SSS 2025/2026 (EN, TR), darkorbitwiki, istemcinin metinleri ve game.xml; tools/buyuk_icerikler.py
world_boss._adaptation: NPC values and attack damages are not in the source (the research's single-player suggestions, s=1); HP scales with the player's power (power); tier thresholds are multiples of the Fortress's HP in the fight; ranking is virtual (from the removed HP share); Guardian shields are additive (4 active = invulnerable).

mimesis._source: mimesis_mutiny.json: official FAQ 2020-2026, darkorbitwiki (Mimesis types, boxes/mimesis-box, galaxy-gates/mimesis-mutiny-gate: Mimesis Chest), the client's texts and game.xml; tools/major_content.py
mimesis._adaptation: The route (4 points + beacon), waves and points are not in the source (the research's suggestions); single-player: waves scale with the player's power (World Boss scale): HP x0.3 x power, damage x0.25 x power (0.5-1.5); the EM Freighter's HP is enough to withstand 240 s of fire from the strongest wave (at least 2,000,000); ranking is virtual (player 1st); company maps: MMO 433, EIC 436, VRU 430 (each company's first Escort map); Byte Remnant goes directly to the type's reward (extra_reward; mimesis._register) and to the box; box quantities, weights and the MINI_BOSS / BOSS mapping are not in the source (normal box: half of the type's Byte reward; elite box: between half and all of it + one row); buff draw in mimesis_chest.py.

kristallon_apotheosis._source: board-en 130459 (FAQ Kristallon Apotheosis); client 1.1.115 (window apotheosis, map 510, portal 307, VisualModifier 158 ice, 159 rift, 160 radiation guide); tools/version_115.py; defeat probabilities and weekly limits from the official server recording (2026-10-25)
kristallon_apotheosis._adaptation: Single-player: the server-wide collection goal is the player's own points (1000); collection aliens per map 4 + 1-2 (copies of Icy, Kristallon, Boss Kristallon, their power is the map's 'power'), respawn in 15 s. The boss's HP, damage and the timing, area and damage of attacks are an adaptation (HP by the player's power, world_boss.scale; +15% per level); phases at 66% and 33%. Weekly rank in single-player from the week's defeat count: 3+ 1st, 2 2nd, 1 4th (rewards when it resets on Sunday). The participation reward is given once the damage dealt exceeds 1% of the boss's HP. The boss comes 30 s after the portal opens (it was 5 min: the boss map stayed empty and looked broken, player report 2026-11-02; no wait in the wiki or the FAQ).
